answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose a data generation pipeline to improve grounded dialog models with access to search engines. To create a dialog-to-search-queries dataset for training the query generation component in such models, we reverse the process, starting from a search query and generating an information-seeking dialog that corresponds to that query.

answer_2.quote: Our metrics are the same as those used in the QReCC dataset, comparing the original and generated queries. These include Rouge-1 Recall for measuring the similarity between two text unigrams, and SBERT embedding semantic similarity for comparing the semantic content of two sentences... We also use Recall@10 to compare the retrieved URLs for the ground-truth query and the generated query.

answer_4.quote: We define a human annotation task to determine whether the dialogs are intent-preserving. Annotators were asked to mark 1 if the dialog is intent-preserving, and 0 otherwise. We use three annotators for each sample, and select their majority vote as the final answer.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to mark 1 if the dialog is intent-preserving, and 0 otherwise.
